free_tier.stated: No free tier. Cheapest plan: Basic (Lean range) at $5/month for 500 GB with unlimited traffic and a ratio limit of 3. The Premium range starts at Fast, $19/month for 1.2 TB. 14-day money-back guarantee.

egress.terms: Unlimited traffic on every plan; network bandwidth is subject to the plan's fair use policy.

reliability_note: Cheapest plan is Basic at $5/month for 500 GB ($10 per TB per month); Premium plans start at Fast, $19/month for 1.2 TB. Traffic is unlimited, subject to a fair use policy.

evidence.proved: Cheapest plan $19/mo for 1.2 TB = ~$15.83/TB/mo, 5x the floor. Unlimited traffic but priced as a premium managed service.
